source.title: noted.computer Turbo blue (MS DOS inspiration)
source.license: Original Primer variable mapping; IBM VGA font by VileR: CC BY-SA-4.0, bundled with attribution and license
source.notes: Adapted from the public Turbo blue palette and VGA typography. Deep blue page, blue panes, cyan text, yellow accents, gray menu bars, green primary actions, square corners and hard shadows evoke DOS-era text interfaces. Semantic reds are brightened for legibility. No application code, artwork or stylesheet is copied. The unmodified, openly licensed VGA font is bundled locally; no runtime connection to the reference site is made.

variables.--fontStack-system: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

source.title: Original Noodles-inspired demo preset
source.license: Original Primer demo adaptation; no reference code, fonts, assets or private content redistributed
source.notes: Visually adapted from a user-authorized reference. Pale navigation, a white rounded document surface, neutral selection, system typography and spacious reading text are mapped to Primer variables. Story-specific header hooks align the project cover controls and wordmark; the cover illustration is original gradient artwork. Muted text is kept readable rather than copying low-contrast navigation text. The reference app is never contacted by this preset.

source.title: The New York Times (newspaper inspiration)
source.license: Original playground preset; no NYT code, fonts, graphics or content redistributed
source.notes: An original newspaper-inspired interpretation, not official NYT tokens or a product replica. White paper, dark ink, serif typography, fine gray rules and restrained blue links are adapted locally. Georgia and Times New Roman use installed fonts; no proprietary typefaces or masthead assets are included. Semantic status colors and visible focus outlines remain distinct; spacing follows the density control.

source.title: Linear dark app screenshot + public tokens
source.license: Public token facts only; no Linear CSS, graphics or fonts redistributed
source.notes: Charcoal surfaces, cool-gray text, fine borders and neutral selection fills adapt the supplied Linear app screenshot. Screenshot grain, gradients and window lighting are approximated with flat colors. Public typography, primary-button and semantic colors are retained; the website accent is slightly lifted for readable text on cards. Metadata and essential input outlines retain readable contrast. Tabs remain a Primer adaptation because the screenshot shows an issue-detail page, not tabs. No Linear CSS or fonts are imported; spacing follows the density control.

source.title: Stripe Dashboard reference + public tokens
source.license: Public token facts only; no Stripe CSS or fonts redistributed
source.notes: Dashboard screenshot colors with public HDS typography and status tokens; fonts use local fallbacks. Sidebar, selection indicators, and active tab text are customized through default-preserving variable hooks, not Stripe-specific component CSS. Primer content and density remain unchanged; this is not an official product replica.

source.title: Apple HIG Materials (inspiration)
source.license: Original playground preset; no Apple code, stylesheets or font assets redistributed
source.notes: An original interpretation, not Apple design tokens or a Liquid Glass replica. Translucent control fills, highlight shadows and rounded primitives suggest glass while content remains opaque and popovers nearly opaque for legibility. No backdrop blur or optical refraction; font stacks use locally available system fonts.
